start: Demo gym as the owner; "Automatic reminders" open

steps.action: Empty the days box of a reminder that is on, or type a number outside its range
user_sees: An error under that row in plain words; "Save changes" greyed out
must_not: A reminder saved with no days
The other rows blocked without a reason

start: Demo gym as the owner; a reminder changed but not saved

steps.action: Tap "Undo changes"
user_sees: The rows go back to the last saved values; "Undo changes" disappears
must_not: A half-undone row

steps.action: Change it again, tap "Save changes", leave the screen and come back
user_sees: The saved values are still there in this visit
must_not: The seeded values back without a refresh

steps.action: Refresh the page
user_sees: The seeded settings again
must_not: The saved change kept after the refresh
